content: Rahab ọkkaan nttọ sa mfon Israẹl

Iwa Joshua kw'ode nnwa kwa Nun ọtzọhm nttọ mfa sa mfon Shitim ka ndubhama, oben bi, “Bọng nọhng atza rom ẹkhọma nduma, kpọng-kpọng e, Jeriko.” Mando kwa bẹ afon atza adim k'ọhọhm kw'ọzaza-kwanọng kw'okpen Rahab, awobha mẹ.
Iwa bẹ atza agbaak ọvaarnọng kwa Jeriko bi, “Kker e, ajinọng bani p'afon Israẹl akk'akwa m'erungiwu nda bi, bẹ akwu arom ẹkhọma nda e.”
Mẹ wọ ofon ọvaarnọng kwa Jeriko ọtzọhm ẹkkaabha ochena Rahab, oben bi, “Kọ tzima ajinọng mba p'akwu adim m'ọhọhm kwọ akwu, kkeri, bẹ akwu bi bẹ akwu arom ẹkhọma nda biphyir.”
Ode cha kwanọng nwa okk'ajinọng mba afa ọtzọkha odubha. Yina, obhina ọvaarnọng bi, “K'odik-ọkka, ajinọng afa akk'aam akwu akhebha mando e. Yina, kaam ibe sa bẹ afon akwu kinnong e.
Ira bẹ afon ka nchọhkha-bọhk, yina ira bẹ an-agbakhi ẹbaakhamma ch'obhon e. Kaam ibe sa bẹ areng afona kinnong e. Bọng nọhng ẹbhar-ẹbhar akhubh bẹ k'eden, asi mẹ, bọng ákhebha bẹ okhebha.”
(Yina, okk'ajinọng mba afa otzima ovura k'ẹnyọhng, otza odubha k'abọhnga pa ngwugwuma p'ọyaani k'ọhọhm ebir-ebir.)
Mando kw'anọng mba akhubhi nttọ nna ka nnam k'eden ch'echin ka Jọrdan. K'ogbe kw'ajinọng p'akhubhi nttọ nna akk'ayina k'iyaan, bẹ abhen ẹbaakhamma ch'obhon.
Yina nttọ nna nttaabha m'erungi nduma, kwanọng nwa ovura k'ẹnyọhng,
ọtza oben bẹ bi, “Kaam nnong kẹ bi, Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi okk'bọng ẹkhọma nda ọnanga e. Bọng ajor man kpọng-kpọng e. Maman anọng p'ẹkhọma nda mon-orukhi k'ojora f'ideden.

Da mọkk'ọbhaanga odem kw'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi osi asi akka k'Ẹraanga-khora, k'ogbe kwa bọng abin k'Ijip. Mobiro ọbhaanga odem kwa bọng asi ọvaar Sihọn ọmaana ọvaar Og, p'ade avaarnọng p'anọng p'Amọr pa bọng adimi biphyir-phyir, k'okhubha kwa Jọrdan kw'ewuchen em-eyin.
Mada mọbhaang kwẹ, nttem iyọhn man, ẹfa ebire ẹha man okhuri bọng. Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi kw'ode Ibinọkpaabyi kwabọng, wọ ọdabhi ẹrọng ọmaana irerek.
“Bọng na chekhi ka che ch'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi bi, bọng asi ejibha osi anang ẹhọhmmọr chaam, okhuri ejibha cha kaam nsi nnang bọng. Bọng nang-m ẹkhọhkha
cha ndima nkhera bi, bọng atte otte kwaam ọmaana ọkka kwaam, ọmaana vọkka paam p'ijinọng ọmaana p'ipanọng ttara anọng pabẹ biphyir, ọbọhk otte. Tzotzokhaan, bọng kkaana man.”

Mẹ wọ ofon, ajinọng mba aben-ẹ bi, “Idikha bọng ape, tte maman obiro ope ọdọk. Abọng ani anọng odik kw'am-omosi ma agbaakhi, k'odik-ọkka, mosi ejibha osi ọnang-ọ, k'ogbe kw'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ọnang man ẹkhọma nda e.”
Mando kw'ọnangi ajinọng mba edik, cha bẹ atzim arenga k'ọphaphamma atto k'ọbaakha okhubha, okhuri da iwa ọhọhm kwa Rahab ọkwọhkhi k'echumi ch'ọbaakha kw'obhon.
On-oben ajinọng mba bi, “Bọng nnọbh achina k'okhubha kwa mgbegbeho, ifha anọng p'am-akhubbh bọng, aningi bọng are. Bọng chubha mẹ k'iwu ittaan maa, bẹ akhuna k'obhon yina bọng an-afona o.”
Mẹ wọ ofon, ajinọng mba aben-ẹ bi, “Maman ohok echekhi nda ohok ch'am-ọkk'ọtzọkha

ttara nttak bi, kọ akpa ọbarakpa-khora m'edik nda ch'am-otzim orenga m'ọphaphamma ọhakha k'ọbaakha-okhubha, ọmaana bi, kọ ayeri atte ọmaana akka, ọmaana vọkka pọ p'ijinọng ọmaana p'ipanọng ttara anọng pọ biphyir, atzima adim k'ọhọhm kwọ.

Idikha ọnọng manda wani ofon k'ọhọhm kwọ oyin k'ẹkpaangaden, akpen pẹ abhakhi anan-ẹ k'eho, odik kwa man arang mẹ. Onode anọng p'awobh k'ọhọhm kwọ ẹtzaanga, ọttọhk manda vani osi bẹ, akpen pabẹ akpekhi man ka nho.
Yina, idikha kọ an-ajaakhi odik kw'am-omosi ma, echekhi nda ch'atzim man mosi, man kẹ́bọkha.”
Kwanọng nwa obhina bi, “Kaam nkk'nkhera. Tte kwẹ ode macha bọng abeni.” Mando kw'otte bẹ ọbọhk, bẹ afona. Ọtzọkha ọbarakpa-khora ọkpa m'edik nduma ch'ọphaphamma.
Mada bẹ afon, bẹ achubha k'okhubha kwa mgbegbeho kw'iwu ittaan maa, ajinọng p'am-akhubh bẹ afona akhuna mbọhk-mbọhk.
Mando kw'ajinọng mba afa abin orenga akpa nnam. Bẹ ahakha abina ka mgbegbeho, awọna atza ajekha ọraanga akhebha Joshua kw'ode nnwa kwa Nun, atzọkha odik kpenamkpen kw'ọkk'ọtta okhebha bẹ, agbaakh-ẹ.
Bẹ aben Joshua bi, “K'odik-ọkka, Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi okk'irerek nnuma biphyir ọtzọkha ọnang man. Anọng biphyir ayọhni nttem k'ojora okhuri man e.”
